text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...It's a completely different ballgame from
facing someone down in real life.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: It leaves something to be desired, but... well, it's entertaining.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Still, though...
How should I put it... I just don't know
when to quit...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, they've got other competitive games too...?
...Then again, I really should call it for today...
No, but still...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa got so absorbed in the fighting game
that she ended up staying up late...
